staged_needles:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS ingest_mv TO ingest_hits AS
WITH (SELECT (groupArray(id), groupArray(regex), groupArray(if(needles_regex = regex AND needles_view = view, arrayElement(needles, 1), '')), groupArray(if(needles_regex = regex AND needles_view = view, arrayElement(needles, 2), '')), groupArray(if(needles_regex = regex AND needles_view = view, arrayElement(needles, 3), ''))) FROM (SELECT id, regex, view, needles, needles_regex, needles_view FROM watch FINAL WHERE active = 1 AND view = 'raw' ORDER BY id)) AS wc_w_raw
SELECT id, tupleElement(wc_hit, 1) AS indicator_id, tupleElement(wc_hit, 2) AS view
FROM ingest_src
ARRAY JOIN arrayConcat(arrayMap(i -> (arrayElement(tupleElement(wc_w_raw, 1), i), 'raw'), arrayFilter(i -> match(v, arrayElement(tupleElement(wc_w_raw, 2), i)), arrayFilter(i -> position(v, arrayElement(tupleElement(wc_w_raw, 5), i)) > 0, arrayFilter(i -> position(v, arrayElement(tupleElement(wc_w_raw, 4), i)) > 0, arrayFilter(i -> position(v, arrayElement(tupleElement(wc_w_raw, 3), i)) > 0, arrayEnumerate(tupleElement(wc_w_raw, 2)))))))) AS wc_hit
rule_join:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW `percolator_mv` TO `ingest_hits` AS
SELECT src.id AS id, rule.id AS indicator_id, 'raw' AS view
FROM (
    SELECT id, v, arrayJoin(if(length(v) > 256, ['_wc_long_value'], arrayConcat(arrayDistinct(arrayMap(i -> substring(v, i + 1, 3), range(toUInt64(greatest(toInt64(least(length(v), 256)) - 2, 0))))), ['_wc_no_anchor']))) AS gram_key
    FROM `ingest_src`
) AS src
ALL INNER JOIN (
    SELECT id, regex, bound_needles,
           arrayJoin([if(length(arrayElement(bound_needles, 1)) = 3 AND arrayAll(i -> ascii(substring(arrayElement(bound_needles, 1), i, 1)) BETWEEN 32 AND 126, [1,2,3]), arrayElement(bound_needles, 1), '_wc_no_anchor'), '_wc_long_value']) AS gram_key
    FROM (
        SELECT id, regex, if(needles_regex = regex AND needles_view = view, arraySlice(needles, 1, 3), CAST([], 'Array(String)')) AS bound_needles
        FROM `watch` FINAL WHERE active = 1 AND view = 'raw'
    )
) AS rule ON src.gram_key = rule.gram_key
WHERE arrayAll(n -> position(src.v, n) > 0, rule.bound_needles)
  AND match(src.v, rule.regex)
